scope: Local transfer diagnostic, not a paper reproduction or benchmark leaderboard submission.
rawArtifacts: Raw task trajectories remain local and ignored. SHA-256 identifies captured artifacts, but is not a public replay archive.
measurementNotes: An explicit compactionArm resolves the effective worker policy and overrides the legacy contextPolicy field in the SWE host configuration.
inputTokens includes cached tokens and all completed worker and recap responses; partial totals require usageComplete=false.
cacheTokens and uncachedInputTokens are null unless every started request has a valid completed response with cache usage.
peakInputTokens is the maximum completed provider response input, including recaps, not a measurement of serving memory.
Run quiescence is captured at Run finish; late model responses can settle later in final logs.
Billed cost is unmeasured. Failed early runs cannot establish efficiency improvements.
Fixed-history retention checks cover selected fields, not comprehensive semantic fidelity; manual review found incorrect inspection counts.
